# Markdown for Nanobug 0.17.2

- Preserve task checkbox identities, keyboard focus and checked state across local reparsing.
- Check the 256 KiB derived preview boundary before parsing, retaining editable source and current document revisions without raising host or WASM quotas.
- Recover normal empty and small previews after retiring an oversized cache, including an empty SDK locale.

Validation: 76 plugin unit tests and all 88 actual WASM/native Markdown acceptance scenarios passed on Windows x86_64. Installation ID and permissions remain unchanged.

# Markdown for Nanobug 0.17.1

- Publish the existing plugin from its independent official repository using the pinned public Nanobug SDK.
- Preserve installation ID `markdown`, settings and private data; include standalone build instructions and the original license notices.
- This release changes distribution metadata and packaged documentation. It does not redesign plugin business behavior.
